trust_region_overlay: Ten Rust source files authenticated against source_manifest_after_fmt.json before isolated checkout edits
scope: Fixed F32 linear guard durability, current-content revalidation, exact restoration, privacy and bounded retention; no neural-network capability or trading evaluation
real_crash_method: Owned subprocess SIGKILL after a cfg(test)-only phase marker; wait for signal death; start a fresh process with the exact request and same isolated state
failure_case_requirement: accepted=false; recovery_verified=false; no invented restoration or new published artifact
concurrency: A live owned subprocess holds the journal flock after intent; a second independent process must fail busy after the fixed 10-second lock deadline; killing the owner then permits explicit conservative recovery
additional_checks: completed retry reruns current authentication and preserves immutable receipt
complete request, state, ordered roots and named semantics binding
one-MiB canonical request cap and finite JSON round-trip
owned 0700 directories and 0600 singly linked files
accepted artifact tampering and parent source change denial
changed stored metrics cannot bypass fresh execution
128-entry and 64-MiB retention quotas include abandoned staging
L2 or label prepublication refusal is not bypassed by interrupted recovery
failure_policy: Retain each attempt source hashes, command exit, logs and measured costs. Fix software defects explicitly and create a new attempt; never replace a failed attempt with a claimed pass.
remaining_limits: SIGKILL process recovery does not certify filesystem/device behavior under actual power loss
private owned state assumes the same UID and privileged administrator are trusted
named source fingerprint is not a complete compiler/OS/transitive execution closure
explicit same-request reconcile is not automatic background rollback
full final integrated source qualification remains separate from this focused journal test run
